name: Engineering Thermodynamics
description: Introduction: microscopic and macroscopic points of view. Basic concepts and definitions – system, boundary, equilibrium, steady state, zeroth law, temperature scale. Generalised definition of work and heat – definition and applications; various forms of work - compression, elastic, electric, magnetic, surface tension etc. Thermodynamic properties of a pure substance, use of property tables, ideal and real gases, compressibility chart. The First Law of Thermodynamics for control mass/ volume, Internal Energy, Enthalpy, The SSSF and USUF Processes. Second Law – corollaries, Carnot cycle. Clausius inequality, entropy. Irreversibility and exergy analysis. Thermodynamic Relations. Vapor power cycles – Rankine cycle and its modifications. Brayton/ Otto/ Dual cycles. Vapor compression refrigeration cycle.
